chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 世为婚、应为姻，须要相生相合；鬼为夫、财为妇，最嫌相害相刑

rule.yi: 世爻代表男家，应爻代表女家，要相生相合；官鬼是丈夫，妻财是妻子，最怕互相害、互相刑。生合的地方要防冲克，恐怕快成了又被破坏；冲克的地方若得生扶，反而有人从中撮合。财、官都要旺相才吉，最怕三刑六害发动。
rule.en: The Self line stands for the man's family and the Other line for the woman's family, and they should generate and combine with each other; Pressure is the husband and Wealth is the wife, and what is most disliked is their harming and punishing each other. Where there is generation and combination guard against a clash, for fear that what is about to be made is broken up; where there is clash and control, if support comes, someone steps in to help the match along. Wealth and Pressure should both be strong to be lucky, and most disliked are the three punishments and six harms when they move.

yi: 世爻是婚，
应爻是姻，
要相生相合；
en: The Self line is the groom's side,
the Other line is the bride's side,
and they should generate and combine with each other;

zh: 相生相合，定有成就之象。
生合处，须防冲克，恐将成而被破阻。
冲克处，若得生扶，不成之际得人赞协矣。
yi: 世爻是男家，应爻是女家。
相生相合，一定有成就的象。
生合的地方，要防冲克，恐怕快成了又被破坏阻隔。
冲克的地方，如果得到生扶，在不成的时候会有人出来帮着说合。
en: The Self line is the man's family and the Other line the woman's family.
If they generate and combine, this is surely a sign of success.
Where there is generation and combination, guard against a clash or control, for fear that what is about to be made is broken up and blocked.
Where there is clash or control, if support comes, then at the moment of failing someone will step in to help it along.

yi: 官鬼是丈夫，
妻财是妻子，
最怕互相害、互相刑。
en: Pressure is the husband,
Wealth is the wife,
and what is most disliked is their harming and punishing each other.

zh: 财鬼皆要旺相为吉，最嫌三刑六害，发动成凶。
yi: 财、官都要旺相才吉，最怕三刑六害，发动就成凶。
en: Wealth and Pressure should both be strong to be lucky; most disliked are the three punishments and the six harms, which turn unlucky when they move.

note.yi: 这一章开头两句（「天命禀有生之初，非今可易」「夫妇乃人伦之大，自古为先」）是感慨，不是断法，本库没有收。「婚」「姻」按注文是男家、女家。
note.en: The two opening lines of the chapter ('fate is received at the start of life and cannot now be changed' and 'husband and wife are the greatest of human bonds, first since antiquity') are reflections and not rules, and are not included. By the note, 'hun' and 'yin' are the man's family and the woman's family.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 阴阳得位为佳、夫妇俱全协吉；占婚用爻首要财鬼，二者俱全大吉，不上卦或落空其婚难成

rule.yi: 阴阳各在其位为好，夫妻双方都在（财、官俱全）就和谐吉利。阴阳得位有两种：卦象外阴内阳，或者应爻阴、世爻阳。占婚以财、官为首要的用爻，俱全大吉；男占女以财为主，女占男以官鬼为主。财、官不上卦或落空，婚事难成，成了也不吉。
rule.en: Yin and yang each in its place is good, and husband and wife both present (Wealth and Pressure complete) is harmonious and lucky. Being in place takes two forms: a hexagram with yin outside and yang inside, or the Other line yin and the Self line yang. In a marriage divination Wealth and Pressure are the first Subject lines, and both present is very lucky; a man divining a woman takes Wealth as the main line, and a woman divining a man takes Pressure. If Wealth and Pressure are absent from the hexagram or fall Void, the marriage is hard to make, and even if made it is not lucky.

yi: 阴阳得位为好，
夫妇双全就和谐吉利。
en: Yin and yang each in its place is good,
and husband and wife both present is harmonious and lucky.

zh: 阴阳得位有两端：有封象外阴内阳，有应阴世阳，二者皆为得位。
一阴一阳之谓道，纯阴纯阳之谓鬼。
yi: 阴阳得位有两种：卦象外阴内阳，或者应爻阴、世爻阳，这两种都算得位。
一阴一阳叫做道，纯阴纯阳叫做鬼。
纯阴不能生，纯阳不能化。
一阴一阳，就是夫和妇。
en: Being in place has two forms: a hexagram image with yin outside and yang inside, or the Other line yin and the Self line yang; both count as being in place.
One yin and one yang is called the Way; pure yin or pure yang is called a ghost.
Pure yin does not give birth, pure yang does not transform.
One yin and one yang make husband and wife.

zh: 又曰：占婚用爻，首要财鬼。
一云：男占妇以财为主，女占夫以鬼为主，其理仿此。
yi: 又说：占婚的用爻，首要是财和官鬼。
两者俱全，称为大吉。
另一种说法：男占女以财爻为主，女占男以官鬼为主，道理相同。
en: It is also said: in a marriage divination the Subject lines are, first of all, Wealth and Pressure.
When both are present it is called very lucky.
Another version says: a man divining a wife takes Wealth as the main line, a woman divining a husband takes Pressure as the main line, and the reasoning is the same.

zh: 设或财鬼不上卦，或落空亡，其婚难成。
yi: 如果财、官不上卦，或者落空亡，这门婚事难成。
即使成了，也不吉利。
en: If Wealth and Pressure are absent from the hexagram, or fall Void, the marriage is hard to make.
Even if it is made, it is not lucky.

note.yi: 注里的「封象」多半是「卦象」之误，译文照卦象译。「纯阴纯阳之谓鬼」的「鬼」书里没有解释，照字面译作 ghost。
note.en: 'Feng xiang' in the note is most likely a slip for 'gua xiang', the hexagram image, and is translated so. The book does not explain 'ghost' in 'pure yin or pure yang is called a ghost', which is translated literally.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 世生应乃男求女，应生世乃女贪男；应生世逢墓绝尚在踌躇，世生应被日辰冲克男意被间阻

rule.yi: 世爻生应爻，是男方求女方；应爻生世爻，是女方贪男方。应虽然生世，但遇到墓、绝，女方还在犹豫；有动爻来生，要靠媒人出力。世爻生应，但世爻被日辰冲克，男方心意再浓，也会被人间阻，事情又难成。
rule.en: The Self line generating the Other line means the man seeks the woman; the Other line generating Self means the woman is keen on the man. Though the Other line generates Self, if it meets tomb or extinction she is still hesitating; if a moving line generates it, it must rely on the go-between's efforts. If Self generates Other but Self is clashed or controlled by the Day, then though the man's intent is strong he is blocked by someone, and the matter is again hard to make.

yi: 世爻生应爻，
是男方求女方；
应爻生世爻，
是女方贪男方。
en: The Self line generates the Other line,
so the man seeks the woman;
the Other line generates Self,
so the woman is keen on the man.

zh: 且如应虽生世，奈缘逢墓绝，虽然相贪，尚在踌躇之际。
若得动爻相生，必赖媒妁之力。
如世爻生应，奈世被日辰冲克，男意虽浓，被人间阻，事体又在难成也。
yi: 比如应爻虽然生世，但遇到墓、绝，虽然相贪，还在犹豫不决的时候。
如果有动爻来生它，必定要靠媒人出力。
又如世爻生应爻，但世爻被日辰冲克，男方心意虽然浓，却被人从中阻隔，事情又难成了。
en: Take the case where the Other line generates Self but meets tomb or extinction: though she is keen, she is still hesitating.
If a moving line generates it, it must rely on the go-between's efforts.
Or if the Self line generates the Other line but Self is clashed or controlled by the Day, then though the man's intent is strong he is blocked by someone, and the matter is again hard to make.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 世位逢空男心退悔，应爻有动女意更张；世空男悔、应空女悔，世应俱动必改张

rule.yi: 世爻落空，男方心意退缩后悔；应爻发动，女方心意就会更改。世空男悔，应空女悔，即使有吉神也难成。世应都发动，事情一定有更改；发动的爻若被日辰合住，不管愿不愿意也要成。
rule.en: Self meeting Void, the man's heart draws back in regret; the Other line moving, the woman's intent is sure to change. Self Void means the man regrets, Other Void means the woman regrets, and even with a lucky spirit it is hard to make. If Self and Other both move, the matter is sure to be altered; if the moving line is combined by the Day, whether or not you wish it, it will be made.

yi: 世爻逢到空，
就会看到男方心意退缩后悔；
应爻发动，
女方心意一定更改。
en: The Self position meeting Void,
one will see the man's heart draw back in regret;
the Other line moving,
the woman's intent is sure to change.

zh: 若世应俱发动，必然事有改张。
动处若逢日辰合，任君不愿也须成。
yi: 世爻空，男方后悔；应爻空，女方后悔。
即使有吉神，也难成。
如果世应都发动，事情一定有更改。
发动的爻若遇到日辰合，不管你愿不愿意也要成。
en: Self Void: the man regrets; Other Void: the woman regrets.
Even with a lucky spirit it is hard to make.
If Self and Other both move, the matter is sure to be altered.
If the moving line is combined by the Day, whether or not you wish it, it will be made.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 世应比和功全资于媒约，阴阳交错事亦系乎因缘：世应比和本无成理，须媒爻动合世应；阴阳交错世应不得位，大象可成亦当入赘

rule.yi: 世应比和（不生不克），本来没有成就的道理，要靠媒爻发动、合住世应才能成。阴阳交错，是世应没有得位；如果大势能成，也应当是入赘，否则夫妻互相欺凌。
rule.en: When Self and Other are in harmony as equals, with neither generating nor controlling, there is by itself no reason for success, and it needs the go-between line to move and combine with Self and Other. Yin and yang crossed means that Self and Other are not in their proper places; if the overall image allows it to be made, it should be a match in which the man enters the wife's household, or husband and wife will overbear each other.

yi: 世应比和，
成全要靠媒人的约定；
阴阳交错，
事情也系于因缘。
en: Self and Other in harmony as equals,
success depends on the go-between's arrangement;
yin and yang crossed,
the matter also hangs on fate's connection.

zh: 世应比和，本无成就之理。
若得媒爻动合世应，其事亦成。
阴阳交错，乃世应不得位也。
若大象可成，亦当入赘，不然，夫妇相凌也。
yi: 世应比和，本来没有成就的道理。
如果媒爻发动来合住世应，这件事也能成。
阴阳交错，是世应没有得位。
如果大势可以成，也应当是入赘；不然，夫妻会互相欺凌。
en: When Self and Other are in harmony as equals there is by itself no principle of success.
If the go-between line moves and combines with Self and Other, the matter can still be made.
Yin and yang crossed means that Self and Other are not in their proper places.
If the overall image allows it to be made, it should be a match where the man enters the wife's household; otherwise husband and wife will overbear each other.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 应旺则女室丰隆，世墓乃男家贫乏：夫占妇看应位月建、妇占夫看世爻，入墓休囚必贫，本宫旺而世鬼衰只是虚名

rule.yi: 应爻旺，女方家里富足；世爻入墓，男方家里贫乏。男占女，应爻在月建上旺，是富户，但日下休囚，就是近年略有衰退；女占男，世爻要旺相，男家才豪富，入墓、休囚必然贫乏；本宫虽然旺，但世爻和官鬼都衰，只是虚名。
rule.en: The Other line strong means the woman's household is abundant; Self in the tomb means the man's family is poor. When a husband divines a wife, if the Other line is strong in the Month, it is a wealthy family without office, but if it is resting and trapped under the Day, its wealth has slipped somewhat in recent years; when a wife divines a husband, Self must be strong for the man's family to be rich, and in the tomb or resting and trapped it means poverty; if the home palace is strong but Self and Pressure are both weak, it is only an empty name.

yi: 应爻旺，女方家里就富足丰隆；
世爻入墓，就是男方家里贫乏。
en: The Other line strong, the woman's household is abundant and prosperous;
Self in the tomb means the man's family is poor.

zh: 夫占妇，若应位月建旺，乃素封之家。
若月建虽旺，日下休囚，必近年稍退资财。
若妇占夫，要世爻旺相，则男家豪富；
本宫虽旺，而世鬼俱衰，止是虚名而已。
yi: 男占女，如果应爻在月建上旺，就是有钱而没有官位的富户。
如果月建上虽然旺，但在日辰下休囚，一定是近年来资财略有衰退。
女占男，要世爻旺相，男家才豪富；
入墓、休囚，必定贫乏。
本宫虽然旺，但世爻和官鬼都衰，只是虚名罢了。
en: When a husband divines a wife, if the Other line is strong in the Month, it is a wealthy family without office.
If it is strong in the Month but resting and trapped under the Day, its wealth has surely slipped somewhat in recent years.
When a wife divines a husband, Self must be strong for the man's family to be rich and powerful;
in the tomb, or resting and trapped, it surely means poverty.
If the home palace is strong but Self and Pressure are both weak, it is only an empty name.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 子孙发动中途必见伤夫，兄弟交重异日终须失妇：子孙宜静不宜动，动而带贵妻夺夫权，鬼旺不受克加天寡凶杀必伤夫；兄弟克财发动必丧偶

rule.yi: 子孙发动，中途会伤夫；兄弟交重，日后要丧妻。子孙是福德，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动：动而带贵人、临吉神，是妻夺夫权；官鬼旺而不受克，再加天寡和凶煞，一定伤夫；旺相来得急，休囚来得缓。兄弟克财，发动必丧偶；有官鬼动，或者日辰冲破它，才能化解。
rule.en: When Output moves, the husband will surely be harmed midway; when Peer moves, the wife will be lost in the end. Output is fortune and virtue and cannot be absent from the hexagram, but it should be still and not move: moving with the Noble and a lucky spirit, it is the wife seizing the husband's authority; if Pressure is strong and uncontrolled and adds the Heavenly Widow star and fierce stars, it surely harms the husband; strong, it comes quickly, resting or trapped, slowly. Peer controls Wealth, and if it moves the spouse is surely lost; only if Pressure moves, or the Day clashes and breaks it, can it be resolved.

yi: 子孙发动，
中途一定会见到伤夫；
兄弟交重，
日后终究要失去妻子。
en: When Output moves,
the husband is sure to be harmed midway;
when Peer moves,
the wife will be lost in the end.

zh: 子孙为福德，卦中不可无，宜静不宜动。
若带贵临吉神动，乃妻夺夫权；
或鬼旺不受克，若加天寡及凶杀，必主伤夫。
兄弟为克财，若发动必丧其偶。
若得鬼动，及日辰冲破，庶可解。
yi: 子孙是福德，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动。
如果带贵人、临吉神而动，就是妻子夺了丈夫的权；
或者官鬼旺而不受克，再加天寡和凶煞，一定伤夫。
旺相来得急，休囚来得缓。
兄弟克财，如果发动，一定丧偶。
如果官鬼发动，或者日辰冲破它，才可以化解。
en: Output is fortune and virtue; it must not be absent from the hexagram, and should be still rather than moving.
If it carries the Noble and moves with a lucky spirit, the wife seizes the husband's authority;
or if Pressure is strong and not controlled, and adds the Heavenly Widow star or fierce stars, it surely harms the husband.
Strong, it comes quickly; resting or trapped, slowly.
Peer controls Wealth; if it moves, the spouse is surely lost.
If Pressure moves, or the Day clashes and breaks it, it may be resolved.

note.yi: 「天寡」是天寡杀，和「鳏寡杀」是一路的神煞，书里没有另外解释。
note.en: The Heavenly Widow star is the star of widowhood and loneliness; the book does not explain it further.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 财空妻失、鬼空夫亡：财鬼空亡是占婚大忌，本非成就之象，若干支相合、世应相生尚可半世夫妻

rule.yi: 财爻空是妻子失去，官鬼空是丈夫亡故。财、官同时空亡是占婚的大忌，本来不是能成的象；但若干支相合、世应相生，还能做半辈子夫妻。
rule.en: Wealth Void, the wife is lost; Pressure Void, the husband dies. Wealth and Pressure both Void is a great taboo in a marriage divination and by itself is not an image of success; but if the branches combine and Self and Other generate each other, they can still be husband and wife for half a lifetime.

yi: 财爻空，妻子失去；
官鬼空，丈夫亡故。
en: Wealth Void, the wife is lost;
Pressure Void, the husband dies.

zh: 财鬼空亡，占婚大忌，本非成就之象。
若干支相合，世应相生，半世夫妻也。
yi: 财、官同时空亡，是占婚的大忌，本来不是能成就的象。
如果干支相合，世应相生，还能做半辈子夫妻。
en: Wealth and Pressure both Void is a great taboo in a marriage divination and by itself is not an image of success.
If the stems and branches combine and Self and Other generate each other, they can still be husband and wife for half a lifetime.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 男子两财逢二姓丝萝之好，阴人两鬼再一番桃李之鲜：一旺一空是再婚，两财不空带桃花一正一偏，两鬼旺不空遇刑冲克财是生离改嫁

rule.yi: 男占女见到两个财，是先后有过两姓的婚姻；女占男见到两个官鬼，是再有一次婚事。男占女见两财一旺一空，已经做过两次新郎；两财不空、只带桃花，一定是一正一偏。女占男见两鬼一旺一空，必定重婚再嫁；两鬼旺而不空，日辰刑冲财爻，或动爻克财，一定是生离改嫁。
rule.en: A man with two Wealth lines meets a marriage of two surnames; a woman with two Pressure lines has another fresh bloom of peach and plum. A man divining a woman who sees two Wealth lines, one strong and one Void, has been a bridegroom twice; if the two Wealth lines are not Void and merely carry the Peach Blossom star, there is surely one principal wife and one secondary. A woman divining a man who sees two Pressure lines, one strong and one Void, will surely marry again; if both Pressure lines are strong and not Void, and the Day punishes or clashes with Wealth, or a moving line controls Wealth, then there will surely be separation in life and remarriage.

yi: 男子有两个财，
遇到两姓联姻的缘分；
女子有两个官鬼，
又有一番桃李新鲜的婚事。
en: A man with two Wealth lines
meets the tie of two surnames;
a woman with two Pressure lines
has another fresh bloom of peach and plum.

zh: 男占女，见两财一旺一空，曾作两度新郎；
若两财不空，唯带桃花，必一正一偏。
女占男，见两鬼一旺一空，定主重婚再醮；
若两鬼旺不空，日辰刑冲财爻，或动爻克财，必是生离改嫁。
yi: 男占女，见到两个财一旺一空，已经做过两次新郎；
如果两个财都不空，只带桃花，一定是一正一偏。
女占男，见到两个官鬼一旺一空，必定重婚再嫁；
如果两个官鬼旺而不空，日辰刑冲财爻，或者动爻克财，一定是生离改嫁。
en: A man divining a woman who sees two Wealth lines, one strong and one Void, has been a bridegroom twice;
if the two Wealth lines are not Void and merely carry the Peach Blossom star, there is surely one principal wife and one secondary.
A woman divining a man who sees two Pressure lines, one strong and one Void, will surely marry again;
if both Pressure lines are strong and not Void, and the Day punishes or clashes with the Wealth line, or a moving line controls Wealth, then there will surely be separation in life and remarriage.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 财动则伤克翁姑，父兴则难为子息：财爻持世必不能奉事翁姑，静还可、动则刑伤；父母发动难于子嗣，带凶杀生后有损

rule.yi: 财爻发动会伤克公婆；财爻持世，一定不能侍奉公婆，静还可以，动就是刑伤。父母爻发动，子嗣艰难；带凶煞，生后有损伤，得救还可以，逢冲则无害。
rule.en: When Wealth moves it injures the parents-in-law: with the Wealth line on Self she surely cannot serve them; if still it may pass, and if it moves it means injury. When the Resource line moves, heirs come with difficulty; with a fierce star there is harm after the birth, which if rescued may pass, and if clashed does no harm.

yi: 财爻发动，就伤克公婆；
父母爻兴旺，就难有子息。
en: When Wealth moves it injures the parents-in-law;
when the Resource line thrives, children are hard to have.

zh: 财爻持世，必不能奉事翁姑。
安静犹可，若发动，则主刑伤也。
若带凶杀，主生后有损，遇救犹可，逢冲则主无害。
yi: 财爻持世，一定不能侍奉公婆。
安静还可以，如果发动，就主刑伤。
父母爻发动，主子嗣艰难。
如果带凶煞，主生了以后有损伤，得到救助还可以，逢冲则无害。
en: If the Wealth line holds Self, she surely cannot serve her parents-in-law.
If still, it may pass; if it moves, it means injury.
If the Resource line moves, it means difficulty with heirs.
If it carries a fierce star, it means harm after the birth; if rescued it may pass, and if clashed there is no harm.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 财鬼同居一卦必然亲上成亲，前后皆值六冲当见退后还退：财鬼共一卦易成，前卦六冲曾许聘复退、后卦又六冲成后又退，被日辰合住想退不得，前冲后合退后还就

rule.yi: 财、官同在一卦，是容易成的兆头；世应财官相生相合，一定是亲上加亲。前卦六冲，曾经许过聘又退了；后卦又六冲，成了以后还会退；被日辰合住的，想退悔也退不成；前卦冲而后卦合，退了以后又会回头。
rule.en: Wealth and Pressure together in one hexagram is a sign that it is easily made, and if Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure generate and combine with each other it is surely a marriage of relative to relative. If the earlier hexagram is a six-clash hexagram, a betrothal was once promised and then withdrawn; if the later hexagram is a six-clash again, after it is made it will again be withdrawn; if it is held by a Day combination, though one wants to withdraw it cannot be done; if the earlier hexagram clashes and the later one combines, there is a withdrawal and then a return to the match.

yi: 财、官同在一个卦里，
必定是亲上加亲；
前后两卦都是六冲，
会见到退了又退。
en: Wealth and Pressure together in one hexagram,
it is surely a match of kin to kin;
if both the earlier and the later hexagram are six-clash,
there will be withdrawal after withdrawal.

zh: 财鬼共一卦中，此易成之兆。
若世应财鬼相生相合，必然亲上成亲。
前卦值六冲，必曾许聘复退。
后卦又六冲，成后又当见退。
若被日辰合住，虽欲退悔，不可得也。
前卦冲而后卦合，当见退后还就。
yi: 财、官同在一卦之中，是容易成的兆头。
如果世应财官相生相合，必定亲上加亲。
前卦是六冲，一定曾经许聘又退了。
后卦又是六冲，成了以后又会退。
如果被日辰合住，虽然想退悔，也不可能。
前卦冲而后卦合，会退了以后又回头成。
en: Wealth and Pressure together in one hexagram is a sign that it is easily made.
If Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure generate and combine with each other, it is surely a marriage of relative to relative.
If the earlier hexagram is a six-clash hexagram, a betrothal was surely once promised and then withdrawn.
If the later hexagram is a six-clash again, after it is made it will again be withdrawn.
If it is held by a Day combination, then though one wants to withdraw, it cannot be done.
If the earlier hexagram clashes and the later one combines, there will be a withdrawal and then a return to the match.

note.yi: 「前卦」「后卦」按上下文是本卦和变卦。
note.en: 'The earlier hexagram' and 'the later hexagram' are, from the context, the original hexagram and the changed hexagram.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 日辰合世须逢贵客维持，恶杀冲身必被他人说破：日辰带天喜或贵人合世应必有权贵说合，日辰恶杀冲克身世必有小人破阻，动爻来救则无害

rule.yi: 日辰合世爻，会有贵人来维持；恶煞冲身，必被别人说破。日辰带天喜或贵人，合世爻、应爻，一定有权贵的人前来维持说合；日辰带恶煞，冲克身世，一定有小人破坏阻拦；有动爻来救，就没有害处。
rule.en: The Day combining with Self, a person of standing will come to support it; a fierce star clashing with the Body, it is sure to be broken up by others. If the Day carries the Heavenly Joy star or the Noble and combines with Self and Other, some person of standing will surely come to support and arrange the match; if the Day carries a fierce star and clashes or controls the Body and Self, some mean person will surely break it up and block it; if a moving line comes to the rescue, there is no harm.

yi: 日辰合世爻，
必定遇到贵客来维持；
恶煞冲身，
必定被别人说破。
en: The Day combining with Self,
one is sure to meet a person of standing who will support it;
a fierce star clashing with the Body,
it is sure to be broken up by others.

zh: 日辰临天喜，或贵人，合世应，必有权贵之人，前来维持说合。
若日辰恶杀，冲克身世，必有小人破阻。
若得动爻来救，则无害也。
yi: 日辰带天喜，或者贵人，合世应，一定有权贵的人前来维持说合。
如果日辰带恶煞，冲克身世，一定有小人破坏阻拦。
如果有动爻来救，就没有害处。
en: If the Day carries the Heavenly Joy star or the Noble and combines with Self and Other, some person of standing will surely come to support and arrange the match.
If the Day carries a fierce star and clashes or controls the Body and Self, some mean person will surely break it up and block it.
If a moving line comes to the rescue, there is no harm.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 卦无父母则应无雁币迎门，财值青龙则会见鸾妆耀目：父母爻是主婚又是聘仪，卦中无父母必无聘礼；财与青龙会合妆奁丰盛夺目

rule.yi: 卦里没有父母爻，就没有雁币迎门的聘礼：父母爻是主婚人，又是聘礼。财爻遇青龙，嫁妆丰盛，光彩夺目。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Resource line there are no wild-goose-and-silk gifts to greet at the door: the Resource line is the presider at the wedding and also the betrothal gifts. Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means a rich trousseau, dazzling to the eye.

yi: 卦里没有父母爻，
就没有雁币迎门的聘礼
en: If the hexagram has no Resource line,
there are no wild-goose-and-silk gifts to greet at the door

zh: 卦中无父母，必无雁币之礼
yi: 父母爻是主婚人，又是聘礼。
卦中没有父母爻，一定没有雁币的礼仪
en: The Resource line is the presider at the wedding, and also the betrothal gifts.
If there is no Resource line in the hexagram, there is surely no wild-goose-and-silk gift ceremony

yi: 财爻遇到青龙，
会看到鸾妆耀眼。
en: Wealth with the Azure Dragon,
one will see the phoenix-adorned trousseau dazzle the eye.

zh: 财与青龙会合，必妆奁之资茂盛，绚彩夺目。
yi: 财爻和青龙会合，一定是嫁妆的资财丰盛，色彩华丽夺目。
en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means the trousseau will be abundant, its bright colors dazzling.

note.yi: 「雁币」是古时聘礼：雁和币帛。两句注文末尾原书没有句号。
note.en: 'Wild-goose-and-silk' are the traditional betrothal gifts, a goose and bolts of silk. The book's note has no full stop at the end of the two sentences on the gifts.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 鬼化鬼终须反复，兄化兄见阻方成：官鬼是动爻不宜再变，静化还可动化不宜，主事体反复迟滞；兄弟是阻隔之神，兄化兄而大象不吉婚难成

rule.yi: 官鬼化官鬼，终究反复；兄弟化兄弟，受阻才成。官鬼本来是动爻，不宜再变动，静化还行、动化不宜，必定事情反复迟滞；兄弟是阻隔之神，兄弟又化兄弟，如果大象不吉，婚事难成。
rule.en: Pressure changing into Pressure ends in going back and forth; Peer changing into Peer is made only after obstruction. Pressure is a moving line to begin with and should not change further; changing from stillness may pass, changing while moving is unsuitable, and the matter surely goes back and forth and is delayed. Peer is the spirit of obstruction; if Peer changes into Peer and the overall image is not lucky, the marriage is hard to make.

yi: 官鬼化官鬼，
终究反复；
兄弟化兄弟，
受了阻才成。
en: Pressure changing into Pressure,
in the end goes back and forth;
Peer changing into Peer,
is made only after being blocked.

zh: 兄又化兄，若大象不吉，婚难成。
yi: 官鬼本来是动爻，不宜再变动。
静化还可以，动化不适宜。
必定事情反复迟滞。
兄弟是阻隔的神。
兄弟又化兄弟，如果大象不吉，婚事难成。
en: Pressure is a moving line to begin with and is not suited to changing further.
Changing from stillness may pass; changing while moving is unsuitable.
It surely means the matter goes back and forth and is delayed.
Peer is the spirit of obstruction.
If Peer changes into Peer again and the overall image is not lucky, the marriage is hard to make.

note.yi: 「鬼本动爻」「静化」「动化」书里没有再解释，照字面译：静化是静爻变，动化是动爻变。
note.en: 'A moving line to begin with', 'changing from stillness' and 'changing while moving' are not explained further and are translated literally.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 世应三合咸池拟定先通后娶，财鬼一临玄武定知眼去眉来：应与财带咸池玄武合世与鬼必先通后娶，合旁爻必与外人有情；咸池被冲淫而不滥，遇进神生合淫心荡漾，遇退神有欲无实

rule.yi: 世应三合再带咸池，一定是先私通、后娶亲；财、官一同临玄武，一定是眉来眼去。应爻和财爻带咸池、临玄武，又和世爻、官鬼相合，必定先通后娶；和旁边的爻相合，必与外人有情。应爻带咸池玄武，是妻淫；世爻带，是夫淫。咸池被日辰冲，淫而不滥；贵人动来克它，不淫，只是容貌美丽、多情好欢；咸池遇进神动来生合，淫心荡漾；遇退神或被退神克，虽有欲心而没有实事，不过眼去眉来。
rule.en: Self and Other in a three-harmony frame with the Xianchi star, it is settled that intimacy comes first and marriage after; Wealth and Pressure both on the Dark Tortoise, you will know they are exchanging glances. If the Other line and Wealth carry the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise and combine with the Self line and Pressure, there is surely intimacy first and marriage after; if they combine with another line, she is surely attached to an outsider. The Other line with Xianchi and the Dark Tortoise means the wife is licentious; the Self line with them, the husband. If the Day clashes Xianchi, she is licentious without excess; if the Noble moves to control it she is not licentious but fair in bearing, affectionate and fond of pleasure, more so when strong and less when dead or cut off; if Xianchi meets an Advancing spirit that moves to generate or combine with it, the licentious heart wanders and acts as it pleases; if it meets a Retreating spirit, or a Retreating spirit controls it, there is desire but no real deed, only glances and looks.

yi: 世应三合咸池，
拟定是先私通、后娶亲；
财、官一同临玄武，
一定知道是眉来眼去。
en: Self and Other in a three-harmony frame with the Xianchi star,
it is settled that intimacy comes first and marriage after;
Wealth and Pressure together on the Dark Tortoise,
you will know they are exchanging glances.

zh: 应与财，若加咸池，临玄武，与世并鬼合，必是先通后娶。
若与旁爻合，必与外人有情。
咸池若逢日辰冲，虽淫不滥。
若见贵人动来克，却不淫，主其人容仪美丽，多情好欢，逢旺尤甚，死绝稍轻。
若咸池会进神动来生合，其人淫心荡漾，恣意非为。
若会退神，或退神来克，虽有欲心，未尝有实，不过眼去眉来。
yi: 应爻和财爻，如果带咸池、临玄武，又和世爻及官鬼相合，必定是先通后娶。
如果和旁边的爻相合，必定和外人有情。
应爻带咸池、玄武，是妻淫；
世爻带，是夫淫。
咸池如果遇到日辰冲，虽然淫，但不泛滥。
如果贵人动来克它，却不淫，主这个人容貌美丽，多情好欢，逢旺更厉害，死绝稍轻。
如果咸池遇到进神动来生合，这个人淫心荡漾，恣意妄为。
如果遇到退神，或者退神来克，虽然有欲心，并没有实事，不过是眉来眼去。
en: If the Other line and Wealth carry the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise and combine with the Self line and Pressure, there will surely be intimacy first and marriage after.
If they combine with another line, she is surely attached to an outsider.
The Other line with Xianchi and the Dark Tortoise: the wife is licentious;
the Self line with them: the husband is licentious.
If Xianchi is clashed by the Day, though licentious she is not promiscuous.
If the Noble moves to control it, she is not licentious but fair in bearing, affectionate and fond of pleasure, more so when strong and less when dead or cut off.
If Xianchi meets an Advancing spirit that moves to generate or combine with it, the person's licentious heart wanders and acts as it pleases.
If it meets a Retreating spirit, or a Retreating spirit controls it, though there is desire there is no real deed, only glances and looks.

note.yi: 「拟定」是「断定、一定」。「贵人动来克」一句原书文字不易读，译文照字面译。
note.en: 'Ni ding' means it is settled. The sentence on the Noble moving to control it is hard to read in the book and is translated literally.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 要知女貌妍媸，推究财临九曜：财带贪狼俊好、巨门面圆色紫黑、禄存主疾、廉贞貌美而淫、武曲洁白、破军有破相、文曲瘦长柔弱；好者忌冲，恶者怕扶

rule.yi: 要知道女子相貌的美丑，推究财爻带的九曜星。财带贪狼（子）：俊好；带巨门（丑、亥）：脸圆，颜色紫黑；禄存（寅、戌）：主有疾；廉贞（辰、申）：主淫，貌美；武曲（巳、未）：洁白，相貌中等；破军（午）：必有破相；文曲（卯、酉）：形貌瘦长，为人柔弱；左辅（亥）、右弼（巳）同巳位。好的怕冲，坏的怕扶。
rule.en: To know whether the woman is fair or foul, examine the nine luminaries that Wealth carries. Wealth with Tanlang (Zi): handsome; with Jumen (Chou, Hai): a round face, a purplish-black complexion; Lucun (Yin, Xu): illness; Lianzhen (Chen, Shen): licentious, beautiful; Wuqu (Si, Wei): fair, of middling looks; Pojun (Wu): surely a flaw in appearance; Wenqu (Mao, You): a thin, tall figure and a soft, weak character; Zuofu (Hai) and Youbi (Si): as for the Si entry. The good ones fear a clash, the bad ones fear support.

yi: 要知道女子相貌的美丑，
推究财爻所带的九曜。
en: To know whether the woman is fair or foul,
examine the nine luminaries that Wealth carries.

zh: 财带巨门【丑、亥】：其面貌团圆，颜色紫黑；
文曲【卯、酉】：形貌瘦长，为人柔弱；
yi: 用九曜来区别美丑。
如果财带贪狼【子】：俊好；
财带巨门【丑、亥】：她的面貌团圆，颜色紫黑；
禄存【寅、戌】：主有疾病；
廉贞【辰、申】：主淫，相貌美；
武曲【巳、未】：洁白，相貌中等；
破军星【午】：脸上一定有伤残缺损；
文曲星【卯、酉】：身形瘦而长，性格柔弱；
左辅【亥】、右弼【巳】：和上面巳位相同。
好的怕冲，坏的怕扶。
en: Use the nine luminaries to tell fair from foul.
If Wealth carries Tanlang [Zi]: handsome;
Wealth with Jumen [Chou, Hai]: a round face and a purplish-black complexion;
Lucun [Yin, Xu]: illness;
Lianzhen [Chen, Shen]: licentious, beautiful;
Wuqu [Si, Wei]: fair, of middling looks;
Pojun [Wu]: surely a flaw in appearance;
Wenqu [Mao, You]: a thin, tall figure and a soft, weak character;
Zuofu [Hai] and Youbi [Si]: the same as the Si entry above.
The good ones fear a clash, the bad ones fear support.

note.yi: 地支括号是每个星对应的地支。这里的「文曲」在《易冒》的九曜名单里写作「文昌」，是同一个位置的两种叫法。「同巳上」按字面译为和巳位相同。
note.en: The branch names in brackets are the branches each star goes with. 'Wenqu' here is written 'Wenchang' in the Yi Mao's list of the nine luminaries, two names for the same place in the list. 'Same as Si above' is translated literally as the same as the Si entry.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 欲识男材长短，参详鬼值五行；若穷两处精微，更互六神推究：青龙和气俊秀、朱雀快言多口舌、勾陈纯厚稳重、螣蛇有心机多疑、白虎性急狠毒、玄武私曲奸邪

rule.yi: 看男子的才质长短，参看官鬼所值的五行（人都是禀五行而生，形象也不离五行）；再要看透两方面的精微，就用六神来互相推究：青龙，和气俊秀、能干持家；朱雀，快言语、多口舌；勾陈，纯厚稳重、有规矩；螣蛇，有心机、多疑虑；白虎，性急、狠毒不仁；玄武，私曲奸邪，但若有吉神制住，反主聪明伶俐。
rule.en: To know a man's measure, examine the five phase that Pressure sits on (everyone is born endowed with the five phases and the form does not depart from them); and to go further into both sides, use the six spirits in turn. Azure Dragon: gentle, handsome, skilled, able to run a household; Vermilion Bird: quick of speech, many quarrels; Hook Earth: honest, steady and well-mannered; Coiling Snake: scheming and given to doubt; White Tiger: hasty, cruel and unkind; Dark Tortoise: crooked and treacherous, but if a lucky spirit restrains it, it means clever and quick instead.

yi: 要知道男子才能的长短，
参看官鬼所值的五行。
en: To know the measure of the man's talents,
examine the five phase that Pressure sits on.

zh: 凡人禀五行而生，其形象亦不离于五行，当用推详。
yi: 人都是禀受五行而生，形象也不离五行，应当用它来推详。
en: Every person is born endowed with the five phases and the form does not depart from them, so use them to infer.

yi: 要穷究两方面的精微，
再用六神互相推究。
en: To go to the bottom of the fine points on both sides,
use the six spirits in turn to examine them.

zh: 若遇青龙，为人和气俊秀，工巧晓事能家；
朱雀快言语，多口舌，加杀多招诽谤，喜生是非；
勾陈为人纯厚稳重、有规矩，不动则无转变；
玄武私曲奸邪，若有吉神制，则不然，反主聪明伶俐。
yi: 如果遇到青龙，为人和气俊秀，工巧懂事，能持家；
朱雀，快言快语，多口舌，加煞多招诽谤，喜生是非；
勾陈，为人纯厚稳重、有规矩，不动就没有转变；
螣蛇，有心机，多疑虑；
白虎，性急，狠毒不仁；
玄武，私曲奸邪，如果有吉神制住，就不是这样，反而主聪明伶俐。
en: With the Azure Dragon: gentle and handsome, skilled and sensible, able to run a household;
the Vermilion Bird: quick of speech, many quarrels; with a fierce star, it draws slander and likes making trouble;
the Hook Earth: honest, steady and well-mannered; if not moving there is no change;
the Coiling Snake: scheming, given to doubts;
the White Tiger: hasty, cruel and unkind;
the Dark Tortoise: crooked and treacherous, but if a lucky spirit restrains it, not so, and instead it means clever and quick.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 咸恒节泰百年似鱼水之相投，睽革解离一见如炭冰之相遇：四吉卦取阴阳得位，有日辰生合吉神发动欢谐到底，用爻落空凶神冲克不可一概断吉；睽乖革变解散离六冲，占婚皆不利

rule.yi: 咸、恒、节、泰四卦，取它们阴阳得位，如果又有日辰生合、吉神发动，就一直欢喜和谐，像鱼得水；但用爻落空、有凶神冲克时，不能一概断吉。睽、革、解、离一见如炭遇冰：睽是乖，火上泽下、金火同居，必有伤克；革是变，占婚遇到，有争婚改嫁；解是散，占婚宜合不宜分；离是六冲卦，纯阴之象，不吉。
rule.en: Xian, Heng, Jie and Tai are taken for their yin and yang being in place, and if the Day also generates or combines and lucky spirits move, they are harmonious to the end, like fish in water; but if the Subject line falls Void or is clashed and controlled by fierce spirits, one cannot judge them all as lucky. Kui, Ge, Xie and Li at first sight are like charcoal meeting ice: Kui is at odds, with fire above and marsh below and Metal and Fire dwelling together, so there is injury and control; Ge is change, and meeting it in a marriage divination there will be a contested marriage or remarriage; Xie is dispersal, and in a marriage divination it should be together and not apart; Li is a six-clash hexagram, an image of pure yin, and unlucky.

yi: 咸、恒、节、泰，
百年都像鱼和水那样相投。
en: Xian, Heng, Jie and Tai,
for a hundred years as well matched as fish and water.

zh: 咸恒节泰，但取其阴阳得位。
论财鬼俱全，咸卦未得尽美也。
yi: 咸、恒、节、泰，只取它们阴阳得位。
世爻是单、应爻是拆，互不夺伦。
论财、官俱全，咸卦还没有做到尽善尽美。
en: Xian, Heng, Jie and Tai are taken simply for their yin and yang being in place.
The Self line is single and the Other line broken, so they do not overstep each other's order.
As for having Wealth and Pressure complete, the hexagram Xian is not yet entirely perfect.

zh: 以上四卦，若又有日辰生合，吉神发动者，欢谐到底，如鱼得水也。
若见用爻落空、凶神冲克，又不可以一概断为吉也。
yi: 以上四卦，如果又有日辰生合、吉神发动，欢喜和谐到底，如鱼得水。
如果用爻落空、凶神冲克，又不可以一概断为吉。
en: If the four hexagrams above also have the Day generating or combining and lucky spirits moving, they are harmonious to the end, like fish in water.
If the Subject line falls Void or is clashed and controlled by fierce spirits, one cannot judge them all as lucky without distinction.

yi: 睽、革、解、离，
一见面就像炭和冰相遇。
en: Kui, Ge, Xie and Li,
at first sight are like charcoal meeting ice.

zh: 上火下泽，金火同居，岂无伤克？
占婚遇之，当有争婚改嫁。
离者，六冲之卦，纯阴之象，故云不吉。
yi: 睽卦的意思是乖违。
上火下泽，金和火同居，哪能没有伤克？
所以不利。
革卦的意思是变化。
是革除旧的、鼎立新的象。
占婚遇到它，会有争婚、改嫁。
解卦的意思是分散。
占婚宜合不宜分。
离，是六冲卦，纯阴的象，所以说不吉。
en: Kui means at odds.
Fire above and marsh below, Metal and Fire dwelling together: how could there be no injury or control?
Therefore it is not favorable.
Ge means change.
It is the image of casting off the old and setting up the new.
Divining a marriage and meeting it, there will be a contested marriage or remarriage.
Xie means to disperse.
In divining a marriage it should be together and not apart.
Li is a six-clash hexagram, an image of pure yin, and so is called unlucky.

dispute.yi: 按卦名断婚，《增删卜易》的觉子不同意：他自己占到泰卦却是兄弟持世、财爻月破旬空，让人再占得六冲的坤卦，结论是仍以财、官、世、应断，不要执古说（LY.MARRY.ZS.14）。《易冒》站在这一边（LY.MARRY.YM.03）；《易隐》《火珠林》的口诀也是按卦名（LY.MARRY.YY.09、LY.MARRY.HZL.11）。这一条的注文自己也留了余地：四吉卦要有日辰生合才「鱼水」，用爻落空、凶神冲克就「不可一概断为吉」。
dispute.en: Juezi of the Zengshan Buyi does not accept judging a marriage by hexagram names: he himself got Tai with a Peer line on Self and the Wealth line Month-broken and Void, had a second divination cast and got the six-clash hexagram Kun, and concluded that one should keep judging by Wealth, Pressure, Self and Other and not cling to the old sayings (LY.MARRY.ZS.14). The Yi Mao stands on this side of the Tianxuan Fu (LY.MARRY.YM.03), and the rhymes of the Yi Yin and the Huozhulin also go by hexagram names (LY.MARRY.YY.09, LY.MARRY.HZL.11). The note here leaves itself some room: the four lucky hexagrams are 'fish and water' only with the Day generating or combining, and if the Subject line falls Void or fierce spirits clash and control it, 'one cannot judge them all as lucky'.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on husband and wife
units.title: 间爻旺相须知月老英豪，兄位交重定是冰人诡谲，与世应相生相合必然沾亲，如雀虎相克相冲拟定两家相怨；欲知退步须察空亡

rule.yi: 世应中间的爻像媒人：旺相，是豪侠有力的媒人；兄弟发动，媒人从中诈伪；间爻和世应生合，是亲朋结契；朱雀、白虎临世应冲克，联了姻也终究两边怨恶。以上这些如果遇到空亡，就要退一步，不能照上面断。
rule.en: The lines between Self and Other are like the go-between: strong, the matchmaker is heroic, generous and effective; if Peer moves, the matchmaker is deceitful in the middle; if a between line generates or combines with Self and Other, relatives and friends form a bond; if the Vermilion Bird and the White Tiger sit on Self and Other and clash or control, though the families are joined they end in resentment on both sides. If any of this meets Void, step back and do not judge as above.

yi: 间爻旺相，
要知道是豪侠的月老。
en: A between line that is strong,
know that the matchmaker is a bold and capable one.

zh: 世应中间爻象，似乎媒妁，若旺相，主冰人豪侠有力。
yi: 世应中间的爻象，像是媒人，如果旺相，主媒人豪侠有力。
en: The lines between Self and Other are like the go-between; if strong, the matchmaker is heroic, generous and effective.

yi: 兄爻的位置发动，
一定是媒人诡诈。
en: If the Peer line moves,
the matchmaker is surely tricky.

zh: 兄弟动，主作伐之人从中诈伪也。
yi: 兄弟发动，主做媒的人从中诈伪。
en: If Peer moves, it means the matchmaker is deceitful in the middle.

yi: 和世应相生相合，
一定是在一处沾亲。
en: If it generates and combines with Self and Other,
the two sides are surely related.

zh: 间爻与世应生合，必主亲朋结契。
yi: 间爻和世应生合，一定主亲朋结契。
en: If a between line generates or combines with Self and Other, it surely means relatives and friends form a bond.

yi: 如果朱雀、白虎相克相冲，
断定两家互相怨恨。
en: If the Vermilion Bird and the White Tiger control and clash with each other,
it is settled that the two families resent each other.

zh: 朱雀白虎，临于世应冲克，虽联姻眷，终结两边怨恶。
yi: 朱雀、白虎临在世应上冲克，虽然联了姻亲，最终结下两边的怨恶。
en: If the Vermilion Bird and the White Tiger sit on Self and Other and clash or control, though the families are joined, they end in resentment on both sides.

yi: 想知道要不要退一步，
要察看空亡。
en: To know whether to step back,
look at Void.

zh: 此说上文世应相生合，及雀虎相冲克。
若值空亡，即当退步，不可如彼断。
yi: 这是说上文世应相生合，以及朱雀白虎相冲克的情形。
如果遇到空亡，就应当退一步，不能照上面那样断。
en: This speaks of the above: Self and Other generating and combining, and the Vermilion Bird and White Tiger clashing and controlling.
If Void is met, then one should step back and not judge as above.
